2607.28229.title: EMBL AI Librarian: Life-Sciences Knowledge Layer for AI Agents
2607.28229.paper_summary: The web is increasingly accessed by AI agents rather than humans. Every agent needs knowledge, especially in the life-sciences, where agentic pipelines are growing fast. Access to the literature is a crucial part of that need, and resources such as Europe PMC, with over 40M indexed records, are widely used to meet it. Yet these resources were not built for AI agents: they take keywords and complex syntax and return whole papers, so every agent must learn the syntax, issue several searches, and read full papers to find the evidence it needs. We introduce EMBL AI Librarian, a knowledge layer that upgrades the Europe PMC interface for AI agents: an agent asks in natural language and receives evidence that answers it. A single LLM orchestrates the whole knowledge retrieval process: it plans complementary subqueries executed by the live Europe PMC search engine, then reads the selected papers and locates the relevant evidence. We evaluate Librarian across four benchmarks: literature synthesis, claim verification, open-domain question answering, and downstream biology tasks such as protocol questions and sequence manipulation. On ScholarQABench, Librarian improves Citation F1 by more than $16$ points over strong recently published baselines. Used as the retrieval layer of an existing claim-verification pipeline, it increases agreement with expert consensus; and on the open-form LitQA2 benchmark, a GPT-5.4 agent scores about $8$ points higher when grounded in Librarian than with web search. Overall, our results show that equipping life-science agents with the Librarian knowledge layer improves performance across a range of tasks. We release our code publicly at https://github.com/petroni-lab/librarian
2607.28229.paper_summary_zh: 網路越來越多地被 AI 代理而非人類訪問。每個代理都需要知識，尤其是在生命科學領域，代理管道正在快速增長。獲取文獻是滿足這一需求的關鍵部分，而像歐洲 PMC 這樣的資源擁有超過 4000 萬條索引記錄，被廣泛用來滿足這一需求。然而，這些資源並不是為 AI 代理而建的：它們接收關鍵字和複雜的語法並返回整篇論文，因此每個代理必須學習語法，進行多次搜索，並閱讀完整的論文以找到所需的證據。我們介紹了 EMBL AI Librarian，一個為 AI 代理升級歐洲 PMC 界面的知識層：代理以自然語言提問，並獲得能夠回答的證據。一個單一的 LLM 協調整個知識檢索過程：它計劃由實時歐洲 PMC 搜索引擎執行的互補子查詢，然後閱讀所選的論文並定位相關證據。我們在四個基準上評估 Librarian：文獻綜合、主張驗證、開放領域問題回答，以及下游生物學任務，如協議問題和序列操作。在 ScholarQABench 上，Librarian 在強大的近期發表基準上提升了超過 16 分的引用 F1。作為現有主張驗證管道的檢索層，它提高了與專家共識的協議；而在開放形式的 LitQA2 基準上，當基於 Librarian 而非網路搜索時，GPT-5.4 代理的得分高出約 8 分。總體而言，我們的結果顯示，為生命科學代理配備 Librarian 知識層能改善各種任務的性能。我們的代碼已公開發布在 https://github.com/petroni-lab/librarian
